_about: Estimated list prices for every (provider, method, mode) web-router calls, read by web_router.prices. Each figure comes from the vendor's own page at source_url, as of checked; nothing here is negotiated or measured. benchmarks/providers/PRICING.md's tables are generated from this file: edit it, then run `make prices`.
